points.description: Identifies a queue as a data structure that stores a collection of elements.
States that it follows the first in first out (FIFO) principle, i.e. the element added first is removed first. Equivalent wording accepted.
Names the main operations: enqueue (add an element at the rear/back) and dequeue (remove an element from the front).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for naming only one of enqueue or dequeue correctly.
